ai_summary:
AI review of the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform's task-force page, read in full:
- The Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets sits under the full Committee on Oversight and Government Reform (chairman James Comer), alongside a sister task force on defending constitutional rights.
- Chairwoman: Anna Paulina Luna (FL-13); Ranking Member: Jasmine Crockett (TX-30).
- Republican members: Nancy Mace (SC-01), Tim Burchett (TN-02), Lauren Boebert (CO-04), Eric Burlison (MO-07), Eli Crane (AZ-02), Brandon Gill (TX-26).
- Democratic members: Stephen Lynch (MA-08), Raja Krishnamoorthi (IL-08), Dave Min (CA-47).
- The page is primarily navigational (member roster and committee structure); it contains no substantive text on the task force's mandate or actions.
- Record summary was a placeholder ('Awaiting editorial review'); this is the editorial summary written from the primary source.
